definitions.definition: (New Zealand, now historical) A fortified Maori settlement, especially of pre-European times. [from 19th c.]

quote.citation: 2020, Sujit Sivasundaram, Waves Across the South, William Collins, published 2021, page 68:
quote.text: A pa or Māori defence fortification appears at a height on the hill above the bay.

definitions.definition: (New Zealand) Any Maori village or settlement; a kainga. [from 19th c.]
